english: 62-64. She slew Pracaṇḍa with the edge of the circular wheel, Cāmara with Bhiṇḍipāla (i.e. an instrument like a sling to discharge missiles), Mahāmauli with a dagger, and Mahāhanu with a Karpara (‘skull-like weapon’).
